purpose.summary: RTT/1 regime-level intelligence engine for detecting, mapping, and analyzing interlocks between conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
purpose.detail: The Regime Interlock Mapper identifies structural interlocks between RTT regimes (R1–R4), maps cross-regime boundaries, detects regime entanglement, and provides interlock diagnostics for higher-level RTT engines such as the Regime Synthesizer, Paradox Gradient Analyzer, and Coherence Tensor Engine.

ai.ai_keywords: RTT, regime interlock, boundary mapping, entanglement, structural regime analysis
ai.ai_purpose: Provide regime-level intelligence for RTT/1 by detecting and mapping interlocks between conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
ai.ai_operators: RIM-Detect, RIM-Map, RIM-Interlock, RIM-Boundary, RIM-Entangle, RIM-Resolve
